sufficient_sets.text: The block time is the average time it takes for the network to generate one extra block in the blockchain. By the time of block completion, the included data becomes verifiable. In cryptocurrency, this is practically when the transaction takes place, so a shorter block time means faster transactions. Since 2022, the block time for Ethereum is set to exactly 12 seconds, while for bitcoin it is on average 10 minutes.
